categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文集中在长时程记忆与对齐、Agent 工具安全，以及多模态感知与自动评估三个方向。

articles.title: To Align Long, Plan Short: Simulating Diverse Profile-Aligned Students by Realizing Short-Term Plans in Long-Horizon Learning Environments
articles.zh: 对齐长期目标，规划短期行动：在长时程学习环境中通过实现短期计划模拟多样化的画像对齐学生
articles.summary: 如果你在做教育场景的 LLM 学生模拟，这篇提醒你：让模拟学生的长期行为贴合真实画像，靠的是短期计划一步步实现，而不是一次性生成整条长期轨迹。
articles.author: Bahar Radmehr, Jiaxu Zhao 等
articles.body: Simulated students offer a scalable way to test learning platforms and AI tutors before deployment with real students and to augment scarce data for studying learning at scale. Existing LLM-based simulators primarily target short, language-centered interactions. In open-ended learning environments, however, student behavior emerges from patterns across long-horizon interaction trajectories, where turn-level prompting can drift from an assigned behavior profile. We introduce ALPS (Align Long-term by Planning Short-term), a hierarchical simulated student conditioned on observable, environment-specific behavior profiles. Rather than selecting every action independently, ALPS alternates between planning profile-aligned task segments and generating the corresponding actions. We evaluate ALPS in both data-sufficient and data-scarce settings, where supervision comes either from real student trajectories or from a teacher LLM. Across both settings, we compare in-context learning (ICL), supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reward-ranked fine-tuning (RAFT), and their sequential combination (SFT followed by RAFT). Experiments in an inquiry-based physics game and a pharmacy simulation evaluate behavioral density and coverage against held-out real data, and profile consistency using a human-aligned LLM judge. Across both settings, ALPS consistently outperforms turn-level generation, achieving comparable density and judge pass rates under scarce supervision, although coverage remains lower. These results show that hierarchical planning enables faithful, profile-aligned simulation over long interaction horizons, even with limited real student data.
articles.bodyZh: 模拟学生提供了一种可扩展的办法：在真正让学生使用之前，先用它来测试学习平台和 AI 辅导老师，也能补足稀缺数据，帮助研究大规模学习。现有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的模拟器，主要盯着短程、以语言为中心的互动。但在开放式学习环境里，学生行为是从长时间交互轨迹中的模式里冒出来的，这时候如果只在每一轮单独给提示，很容易慢慢偏离事先设定的行为画像。我们提出 ALPS（Align Long-term by Planning Short-term，用短期规划对齐长期行为），这是一种分层式模拟学生，它以可观察、且跟具体环境绑定的行为画像作为输入条件。它不是每一步都独立挑动作，而是在“规划与画像一致的任务片段”和“生成对应动作”之间交替。我们在数据充足和数据稀缺两种场景下评估 ALPS，监督信号要么来自真实学生轨迹，要么来自教师大模型。两种场景里，我们都比较了上下文学习（ICL）、监督微调（SFT）、奖励排序微调（RAFT），以及它们的顺序组合（先 SFT 再 RAFT）。实验放在一个探究式物理游戏和一个药房模拟里，对着留出的真实数据看行为密度和覆盖度，再用和人类判断对齐的大模型评审看画像一致性。两种场景下，ALPS 都稳定胜过逐轮生成；在监督稀缺时，它的密度和评审通过率也能做到相当，不过覆盖度还是偏低。这些结果说明，分层规划能让模拟在很长的交互周期里保持忠实、贴合画像，哪怕真实学生数据有限。

articles.title: TrackMem: Tracking Evolving Beliefs in Long-Horizon Financial Dialogue
articles.zh: TrackMem：长时程金融对话中追踪不断演变的信念
articles.summary: 如果你在做金融对话 Agent，这篇讲的“用户信念会变”值得警惕——记忆不是静态存档，而要跟着对话演化。
articles.author: Austin M. Y. Cheung, Harsh Vardhan Gupta 等
articles.body: Memory systems for LLM agents are evaluated mostly on social dialogue, where facts accumulate and rarely change, so remembering reduces largely to finding the turn in which something was said. Financial dialogue breaks this assumption: figures are revised, stances shift without being restated, rules stated once govern later questions, and a single company is discussed under several analytical lenses. Memory systems that retrieve the passages most similar to a question, or the most recent ones, therefore return superseded values, miss rules that share no wording with the question, and cannot recover a stance spread across sessions. We present TrackMem, a per-speaker graph memory that tracks the history of figures, separates perspectives by entity and lens, and preserves each speaker's actions in chronological order. To evaluate it, we introduce FinLoCoMo, a benchmark of 15 long-horizon investment conversations with 765 questions in two splits: one following the LoCoMo categories and one targeting four failure modes. With two readers, TrackMem outperforms existing memory systems on both splits. On the failure-mode split it reaches 73.9% macro accuracy against 69.4% for the strongest baseline, with the largest gains on questions about revised figures (86.5% against 73.4%).
articles.bodyZh: 现在大语言模型智能体（LLM agents）的记忆系统（memory systems），大多是在社交对话（social dialogue）场景里做评测。这种场景里，事实会越攒越多，但很少发生变化，所以“记住”基本就等于找到某件事是在哪一轮说过的。金融对话（financial dialogue）就不是这个逻辑：数字会被修正，立场会变但不会重新明说，规则只讲一次却要管后面的问题，同一家公司还会从好几个分析视角来聊。于是，那些靠“找和问题最相似的段落”或者“找最近的段落”来工作的记忆系统，就会返回已经过时的数值，漏掉和问题没有字面重合的规则，也没法把分散在多次会话里的立场拼回来。我们提出 TrackMem——一种按说话人划分的图记忆（per-speaker graph memory）：它会追踪数字的变化历史，按实体和分析视角（entity and lens）拆开不同看法，并且按时间顺序保留每个说话人的动作。为了评测它，我们推出了 FinLoCoMo，这是一个包含 15 段长周期投资对话（long-horizon investment conversations）、765 个问题的基准（benchmark），分成两个子集（splits）：一个沿用 LoCoMo 的类别，另一个专门针对四类失败模式（failure modes）。用两个读取器（readers）评测时，TrackMem 在两个子集上都优于现有记忆系统。在失败模式子集上，它达到 73.9% 的宏平均准确率（macro accuracy），而最强基线（baseline）是 69.4%；提升最大的是关于“数字被修正”的问题，86.5% 对 73.4%。

articles.title: Safety4DM: A Vision-Language Framework for Risk-Aware Dynamic Maps in Vehicle-Road-Cloud Collaborative Driving
articles.zh: Safety4DM：车路云协同驾驶中面向风险感知动态地图的视觉-语言框架
articles.summary: 如果你关注自动驾驶里动态地图的安全问题，这篇把视觉-语言模型用到了车路云协同的风险感知上，思路值得借鉴。
articles.author: Zhengshu Zhou, Shaoyu Wang 等
articles.body: Dynamic map (DM) is a core information infrastructure for vehicle-road-cloud (VRC) cooperative autonomous driving. It fuses perception data from multiple sources to overcome the inherent line-of-sight and field-of-view limits of single-vehicle perception. However, DM still falls short on driving safety in two ways. First, DM data specifications already define road conditions semantically, but no pipeline yet turns real-world road observations into fine-grained risk entities in the DM. Second, existing DM systems lack a natural language interface for driving risks. To close these gaps, we propose Safety4DM, a safety-oriented language system for VRC dynamic maps. We first build RoadRisk, a real-world road image dataset that covers four types of road conditions and four risk levels. On this dataset, we fine-tune a vision-language model (VLM) for road safety risk perception. The model outputs structured risk representations that the DM can ingest directly. We then introduce a Safety-aware Step-wise Prompting (SafeStep) mechanism as the natural language query interface of the DM. SafeStep answers queries accurately and also generates actionable driving advice. To build and evaluate this interface, we develop SafeVRC-Sim, a VRC cooperative simulation framework, and SafeDM-QA, a safety question-answering benchmark. Experiments show that even the compact Qwen3-VL-4B reaches 89.83% accuracy on risk perception after fine-tuning. SafeStep also plugs easily into multiple LLM families. With medium and large models (20B and above) from five families, it achieves over 93% natural language query accuracy in every case, which shows strong generalization.
articles.bodyZh: 动态地图（Dynamic Map，简称 DM）是车路云（Vehicle-Road-Cloud，简称 VRC）协同自动驾驶的核心信息基础设施。它能把来自多个来源的感知数据融合到一起，帮车辆突破单车感知天生就有的视距和视野限制。不过，DM 在驾驶安全上还有两个明显短板。第一，DM 的数据规范已经在语义层面把路况定义清楚了，但目前还没有一套流程，能把真实道路上的观测变成 DM 里细粒度的风险实体。第二，现有 DM 系统还缺一个面向驾驶风险的自然语言接口。为了补上这两个缺口，我们提出了 Safety4DM——一套面向车路云动态地图、以安全为核心的语言系统。我们先搭了 RoadRisk，这是一个真实道路图像数据集，覆盖四类路况和四个风险等级。基于这个数据集，我们微调了一个视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Model，简称 VLM），专门做道路安全风险感知。模型会输出结构化的风险表示，DM 可以直接读取。接着，我们引入了安全感知分步提示（Safety-aware Step-wise Prompting，简称 SafeStep）机制，把它作为 DM 的自然语言查询接口。SafeStep 不光能准确回答查询，还能给出可执行的驾驶建议。为了搭建和评估这个接口，我们开发了 SafeVRC-Sim，一个车路云协同仿真框架，还有 SafeDM-QA，一个安全问答基准。实验表明，就连轻量级的 Qwen3-VL-4B，微调后在风险感知上的准确率也达到了 89.83%。SafeStep 还能轻松接入多个大语言模型（Large Language Model，简称 LLM）系列。用来自五个系列的中型和大型模型（200 亿参数及以上）时，它在每种情况下自然语言查询准确率都超过 93%，说明泛化能力很强。

articles.title: RubricWorld: World Model-Guided Rubric Optimization for LLM Graders
articles.zh: RubricWorld：世界模型引导的 LLM 评分器评分细则优化
articles.summary: 如果你在用 LLM 做自动评分，这篇说评分细则本身也能优化，而且用世界模型来引导比人工拍脑袋定细则更靠谱。
articles.author: Hongji Pu, Hang Li 等
articles.body: Rubric optimization improves LLM grading by revising scoring instructions while keeping the grader's parameters fixed. Existing optimizers often judge edits by aggregate validation performance, limiting the supervision they retain about which errors an edit corrects or introduces. Testing each candidate also requires rescoring validation answers, which limits how many edits can be explored within a fixed budget. We propose RubricWorld, a framework that learns from previous edit evaluations to guide further search. Its world model predicts an edit's correction and degradation rates at score boundaries, conditioned on the current rubric state. The training signal comes from paired grading results: scores for the same answers before and after an edit. Predictions select one candidate for direct evaluation, and held-out confidence bounds determine whether it corrects enough target errors while keeping new errors within prespecified limits. Measured effects update the model even when the edit is rejected. Across EIR (National), ASAP2.0, and ASAP-SAS with three frozen LLM graders, RubricWorld achieves the highest score in 20 of 27 metric comparisons. On ASAP2.0, it raises gpt-5-mini accuracy from 18.20% with the original rubric to 46.70%, exceeding the strongest baseline, APO, by 22.60 percentage points. code will be released upon acceptance.
articles.bodyZh: 评分标准优化（rubric optimization）能在不改评分器参数的前提下，通过修改打分说明来提升大语言模型（LLM）的评分效果。现有优化器通常只看验证集上的总体表现来判断一次修改好不好，这就导致它们没保留多少信息，说不清这次修改到底纠正了哪些错误、又引入了哪些错误。而且每试一个候选修改，都得重新给验证集答案打分，预算固定时能探索的修改数量就很有限。我们提出 RubricWorld，一个能从以往修改评估中学习、用来指导后续搜索的框架。它的世界模型（world model）会根据当前评分标准状态，预测一次修改在各分数边界上的纠错率（correction rate）和退化率（degradation rate）。训练信号来自成对的评分结果：同一批答案在修改前和修改后的分数。模型用预测结果挑出一个候选去做直接评估，再用留出集上的置信边界（confidence bounds）判断它是否纠正了足够多的目标错误，同时把新错误控制在预先设定的范围内。就算这次修改被拒了，测出来的实际效果也会拿来更新模型。在 EIR（National）、ASAP2.0 和 ASAP-SAS 上，用三个冻结的 LLM 评分器（frozen LLM graders）测试，RubricWorld 在 27 项指标对比中有 20 项拿到最高分。在 ASAP2.0 上，它把 gpt-5-mini 的准确率从原始评分标准下的 18.20% 提到 46.70%，比最强基线 APO 高出 22.60 个百分点。代码会在论文录用后发布。

articles.title: SurgStream: A Workflow-Anchored Proactive Streaming Framework and Benchmark for Real-Time Surgical Video Understanding
articles.zh: SurgStream：面向实时手术视频理解的以工作流为锚的主动流式框架与基准
articles.summary: 如果你在做医疗视频理解，这篇给了一个跟着手术流程走、主动提前预判的实时框架，还配了基准，省得自己造数据。
articles.author: Ruipeng Ma, Qing Xu 等
articles.body: Surgical video understanding is essential for intraoperative assistance such as workflow monitoring, instrument preparation and procedural documentation. Delivering such assistance in real time requires a model to jointly perceive the ongoing scene, remember past surgical events, and respond before clinically relevant moments pass. Existing approaches provide limited support for jointly retaining procedural evidence and deciding when to respond in streaming surgical video. In this work, we propose SurgStream, a workflow-anchored proactive streaming framework for real-time surgical video understanding. We first introduce Workflow-Anchored Memory (WAM) to record structured instrument-action-target observations and fold them into phase-level summaries, providing compact and queryable surgical memory. Deadline-aware Transition Learning (DTL) is then devised to supervise response states within clinical windows, enabling timely responses before procedural deadlines. We further introduce SurgStream-Bench, comprising 11.7K streaming interactions across various tasks covering real-time perception, backward memory queries, forward proactive QA, proactive alerts and caption memory. Experiments on SurgStream-Bench show gains over state-of-the-art methods, especially in memory and forward proactive QA. The source code will be available.
articles.bodyZh: 手术视频理解（surgical video understanding）对术中辅助（intraoperative assistance）特别关键，比如监控手术流程（workflow monitoring）、提前准备器械（instrument preparation）、把操作过程记录下来（procedural documentation）。要想实时提供这些帮助，模型得能同时看懂眼前正在发生什么、记住之前的手术事件，还要在临床上关键的时刻过去之前就做出反应。现有方法在“既保留过程证据、又判断什么时候该回应”这件事上，对连续不断的手术视频流（streaming surgical video）支持还不够。在这项工作里，我们提出了 SurgStream，一个以工作流为锚点的主动式流式框架（workflow-anchored proactive streaming framework），用来做实时手术视频理解。我们先引入工作流锚定记忆（Workflow-Anchored Memory, WAM），把结构化的“器械—动作—目标”观察（instrument-action-target observations）记录下来，再整理成阶段级摘要（phase-level summaries），形成一套紧凑、能查询的手术记忆（queryable surgical memory）。接着，我们设计了截止时间感知的转场学习（Deadline-aware Transition Learning, DTL），在临床时间窗（clinical windows）里监督模型的响应状态，让模型能在流程截止点（procedural deadlines）前及时给出回应。我们还推出了 SurgStream-Bench，包含 1.17 万条流式交互（streaming interactions），覆盖实时感知（real-time perception）、回溯记忆查询（backward memory queries）、前向主动问答（forward proactive QA）、主动提醒（proactive alerts）和字幕记忆（caption memory）等多项任务。在 SurgStream-Bench 上的实验表明，我们的方法比当前最先进的方法（state-of-the-art methods）表现更好，尤其是在记忆和前向主动问答方面。源代码将会公开。

articles.title: Opening the Black Box of Neural Auction Mechanisms
articles.zh: 打开神经拍卖机制的黑箱
articles.summary: 如果你在用神经网络做拍卖或机制设计，这篇帮你搞清楚这些黑箱模型到底学到了什么、是不是真的满足机制性质。
articles.author: Li Kong, Zilong Liu 等
articles.body: Neural auction design has emerged as a powerful paradigm within automated mechanism design for modern Web platforms. Because these learned mechanisms directly dictate critical economic outcomes, their lack of internal transparency raises significant auditability and trust concerns. Opening this black box \textit{post-hoc} is therefore essential, yet presents two distinctive challenges: (1) activation contexts are dense, correlated numerical profiles devoid of explicit semantic structure, and (2) feature interpretations can only be falsifiably audited if they map to measurable auction states or outcomes. In this paper, we propose a post-hoc white-box auditing framework for unpacking trained neural auctions. Using CITransNet as a representative testbed, we first employ sparse autoencoders to decompose hidden representations while faithfully preserving downstream auction behavior. Anchoring feature interpretations to native economic targets, we validate them through activation prediction and causal interventions to isolate verified features from the reconstruction dictionary. Finally, applying this pipeline across varied auction settings, we show that the verified features can serve as analytical instruments to examine how internal representations modulate strategic misreporting incentives, align with Myerson's optimal auction, and support the diagnosis of individual auctions. Our work highlights the potential of white-box mechanism auditing to build the foundational trust necessary for neural auctions to be deployed as widely adopted Web technologies. To enhance research transparency and facilitate independent inspection, we publicly release the experimental results supporting our findings at https://github.com/Li-Beverly-Kong/opening-neural-auctions.git
articles.bodyZh: 神经拍卖设计已经成为现代网络平台自动机制设计中的一种强大范式。由于这些学习到的机制直接决定关键的经济结果，其缺乏内部透明度引发了重大的可审计性和信任问题。因此，事后打开这个黑箱至关重要，但也带来了两个独特的挑战：（1）激活上下文是密集、相关的数值特征，缺乏明确的语义结构；（2）只有当特征解释映射到可测量的拍卖状态或结果时，才能进行可证伪的审计。在本文中，我们提出了一个事后白盒审计框架，用于解开训练好的神经拍卖。以CITransNet作为代表性测试平台，我们首先采用稀疏自编码器来分解隐藏表示，同时忠实保留下游拍卖行为。将特征解释锚定到原生经济目标上，我们通过激活预测和因果干预来验证它们，以从重建字典中隔离出已验证的特征。最后，将这一流程应用于各种拍卖设置，我们表明已验证的特征可以作为分析工具，用于检查内部表示如何调节策略性虚报激励、与迈尔森最优拍卖对齐，并支持个体拍卖的诊断。我们的工作突出了白盒机制审计的潜力，以建立神经拍卖作为广泛采用的网络技术部署所需的基础信任。为了提高研究透明度并促进独立检查，我们在https://github.com/Li-Beverly-Kong/opening-neural-auctions.git 公开了支持我们发现的实验结果。

articles.title: Beyond Prompt Injection: The Tool Update Gap in LLM Agent Security
articles.zh: 超越 Prompt Injection：LLM Agent 安全中的工具更新缺口
articles.summary: 如果你在给 Agent 接工具，这篇提醒你真正的风险点不在提示词注入，而在工具更新这一环——工具变了，Agent 的认知没跟上。
articles.author: Shiyu Kan, Yue Qi 等
articles.body: Large language model based agents increasingly rely on external tools to invoke services and interact with web resources. These tools can evolve through software updates, yet agentic frameworks may continue trusting them without re-verifying their safety after implementation changes. This tool update gap creates a supply-chain vulnerability in agentic systems: because updated tool code executes outside the LLM's context window, malicious functionality embedded in tool updates can bypass defenses centered on model-visible interactions, leaving agents exposed to stealthy, persistent threats that existing in-context defenses can hardly address. To thoroughly investigate this threat, we introduce ETUDE (Exploiting Tool Updates for Direct Execution), an attack that embeds malicious functionality into updates of initially benign tools to produce compromised tools, while preserving their legitimate tool functionality. Unlike prompt-based attacks, ETUDE operates entirely outside the LLM's context and requires no adversarial instructions, thereby bypassing defenses restricted to model-visible content. We evaluate ETUDE across three representative attack workloads and seven widely used commercial and open-source agentic frameworks, including Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, and Claude Code. The results show that ETUDE achieves a 97.6% ASR while maintaining a 95.9% legitimate task completion rate. We further examine existing defenses and find that they provide insufficient protection against this threat. These findings expose a fundamental blind spot in current agent security practices: trust established for a tool does not necessarily remain valid after its implementation updates.
articles.bodyZh: 现在，基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体（agents）越来越依赖外部工具来调用服务、跟网页资源打交道。这些工具会通过软件更新不断变化，可智能体框架（agentic frameworks）可能还一直信任它们，等工具的实现改过之后也不重新验一遍安全性。这个工具更新缺口（tool update gap）就造成了智能体系统里的供应链漏洞（supply-chain vulnerability）：因为更新后的工具代码是在 LLM 的上下文窗口（context window）外面跑的，所以工具更新里夹带的恶意功能，能绕过那些盯着模型可见交互的防御，让智能体暴露在隐蔽、持久、现有上下文内防御（in-context defenses）几乎挡不住的威胁里。为了把这个问题查透，我们提出了 ETUDE（Exploiting Tool Updates for Direct Execution，利用工具更新实现直接执行）这个攻击：它把恶意功能塞进一开始无害的工具的更新里，做出被攻陷的工具（compromised tools），同时还能保留这些工具原本的合法功能（legitimate tool functionality）。和基于提示词的攻击（prompt-based attacks）不一样，ETUDE 完全在 LLM 上下文之外运行，不需要任何对抗性指令（adversarial instructions），因此能绕过只针对模型可见内容（model-visible content）的防御。我们在三种代表性攻击负载（attack workloads）和七个常用的商业、开源智能体框架上评估了 ETUDE，包括 Gemini CLI、Codex CLI 和 Claude Code。结果显示，ETUDE 的攻击成功率（ASR）达到 97.6%，同时合法任务完成率（legitimate task completion rate）还能保持在 95.9%。我们还检查了现有防御，发现它们对这个威胁的保护不够。这些发现暴露了当前智能体安全实践里的一个根本盲点（blind spot）：你为一个工具建立的信任，不代表在它的实现更新之后还照样有效。

articles.title: MUPA${}^2$S: Multimodal Unified Perception with Asymmetric Attention for Stress Assessment
articles.zh: MUPA²S：面向压力评估的基于非对称注意力的多模态统一感知
articles.summary: 如果你做多模态情绪或压力识别，这篇的非对称注意力说明：不同模态不该平等对待，权重怎么分配才是关键。
articles.author: Stefanos Gkikas, Thomas Kassiotis 等
articles.body: Stress is a leading contributor to long-term physical and mental health decline. The automatic assessment of stress is a promising approach for continuous monitoring and mitigating human biases. However, the development of automated systems remains challenging due to the heterogeneity of physiological and behavioral signals. This paper presents MUPA${}^2$S, a multimodal framework for automatic stress assessment that combines facial video and ECG signals within a unified perception architecture. Both modalities are mapped into a shared token representation without modality-specific components, and processed through asymmetric attention comprising segment-local cross-attention and global self-attention across segment states. Experiments on a newly collected 58-subject stress dataset, evaluated under a stratified subject-level protocol, show that facial video achieves 69.44% test accuracy, while ECG-only performance remains close to chance under the proposed representation. Unified Video-ECG fusion achieves a test accuracy of 69.58% at approximately half the number of parameters of feature-level fusion, with negligible additional computational cost. Feature-level fusion does not exceed the video-only baseline, while unified input-level integration provides a parameter-efficient mechanism for jointly processing the two modalities.
articles.bodyZh: 压力(stress)是导致人长期身心健康下滑的一大元凶。对压力做自动评估(automatic assessment)，是持续监测并减少人为偏见的一条有前景的路子。不过，要开发自动化系统并不容易，因为生理和行为信号(physiological and behavioral signals)本身差异很大、很不统一。这篇论文提出了 MUPA${}^2$S，一个自动压力评估的多模态框架(multimodal framework)，把面部视频(facial video)和心电图信号(ECG signals)放进同一个统一感知架构(unified perception architecture)里。两种模态都被映射成共享标记表示(shared token representation)，不依赖模态特定组件(modality-specific components)，再通过非对称注意力(asymmetric attention)来处理，包括段内局部交叉注意力(segment-local cross-attention)，以及跨段状态的全局自注意力(global self-attention)。在一个新收集的、包含58名受试者的压力数据集上，按分层受试者级协议(stratified subject-level protocol)评估，结果显示：面部视频的测试准确率(test accuracy)达到69.44%，而只用ECG时，在这种表示下表现几乎接近随机水平(chance)。视频和ECG的统一融合在测试中达到69.58%的准确率，参数量大约是特征级融合(feature-level fusion)的一半，额外计算成本几乎可以忽略。特征级融合没有超过只用视频的基线，而统一的输入级整合(input-level integration)则提供了一种参数高效(parameter-efficient)的机制，把两种模态放在一起联合处理。
